title: The shared roster opens in dependable stages
summary: Load clinical roster data in smaller dependable stages and leave support information until after the app opens.
changes: Essential staffing and tonight’s allocations now load in two smaller stages instead of one eleven-request block.
Settings, schema diagnostics and the realtime revision marker load after the clinical roster is visible.
Try again waits for an active request to finish before starting a genuinely fresh attempt.
No changes to roster, staffing, allocation, Pager, Reliever, five-nurse, realtime, privacy or database rules.
